name: Rizuhble's Guy Fawkes Geist
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Health
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Getting bursted in lane while you're low from your own bombs. Sell it when slots fill.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-7,200 (levels 1-13). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Essence Bomb T3, Soul Exchange unlocked. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Radiant Regeneration. Ultimate (Soul Exchange) is available from Radiant Regeneration.

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spirit Resilience, 12000 souls (~12.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Radiant Regeneration completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Radiant Regeneration completes 4.8k spirit in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Mystic Regeneration
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Radiant Regeneration completes 3,200 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Radiant Regeneration completes 4.8k spirit in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 12.2 to Essence Bomb's damage (1.22x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Radiant Regeneration
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Regeneration (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.caption: Imbued on Essence Bomb: widens its radius.
items.why: imminent: Improved Spirit completes 6.4k spirit in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 22 to Essence Bomb's damage (1.22x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 5,600 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 7,200-22,400 (levels 13-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Malice T3. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Spirit Resilience.

items.name: Healing Booster
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spirit Resilience, 4800 souls (~4.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spirit Resilience, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 20 to 42 vitality bonus. Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Your own bombs hurt you with spirit damage, so this cuts that too.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Essence Bomb (261) clears its 165-damage trigger; Malice stays under it. Takes spirit from 6,400 to 8,800 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Essence Bomb: takes 18% off its 9s base cooldown.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 10,400 to 12,000 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 216s; 20% off is 43.2s per full rotation.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Soul Exchange silence radius (25m), Life Drain max range (28m), Essence Bomb radius (9m). Takes spirit from 13,600 to 16,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 22,400-56,000 (levels 26-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Life Drain T3, Soul Exchange T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Essence Bomb, damage) grows from 283 to 393.

items.name: Leech
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 36.6 to Essence Bomb's damage (1.22x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 20,800 to 25,600 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 25,600 to 32,000 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Essence Bomb: resets its 9s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Leech? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Healing Booster.
sections.desc: Dying after Leech? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Healing Booster.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They dive you and you've got no way out.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Silences and hexes keep shutting down your abilities.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: Lash ult, Infernus ult. Anything big you can see coming.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry is melting you.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep cutting your drain and Soul Exchange.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Their burst kills you before you can swap. Don't buy it if they have Cursed Relic.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Indomitable
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 11,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Healing Booster for 4,800 more souls: bonus fire rate 0 to 35; tech resist 0 to 10..
